filing-er27-520-pjm-tos-large-loads.point: The owners say the revisions answer the E-7 show cause order and comply with the E-2 co-location order.
filing-er27-520-pjm-tos-large-loads.quote: These revisions are both responsive to and consistent with the preliminary findings made by the Commission in its June 18, 2026 Order Instituting Proceeding

filing-er27-520-pjm-tos-large-loads.point: Large Load customers would make a minimum contribution to transmission revenue requirements, backed by shortfall payments and financial security.
filing-er27-520-pjm-tos-large-loads.quote: to make a minimum contribution towards transmission owners’ revenue requirements, along with a shortfall payment and crediting mechanism and financial security obligations

filing-er27-520-pjm-tos-large-loads.point: The committed contribution is 80% to 100% of a full firm transmission service benchmark.
filing-er27-520-pjm-tos-large-loads.quote: which percentage shall be no less than 80% and no greater than 100%

filing-er27-520-pjm-tos-large-loads.point: Initial credit support equals the projected charges on the full initial load commitment over the agreement’s term.
filing-er27-520-pjm-tos-large-loads.quote: equals the aggregate projected charges associated with 100 percent of the Initial Load Commitment over the CRA term

filing-er27-520-pjm-tos-large-loads.point: The cost recovery agreement runs at least ten years after the first service date.
filing-er27-520-pjm-tos-large-loads.quote: the date that is at least ten (10) years after the first Service Date as specified in Exhibit A

filing-er27-520-pjm-tos-large-loads.point: Owners may keep using existing or new customer protections instead of the pro forma agreement if FERC accepts them.
filing-er27-520-pjm-tos-large-loads.quote: as alternatives to the pro forma CRA, so long as those arrangements result in comparable protections and are accepted for filing by the Commission

filing-er27-520-pjm-tos-large-loads.point: Upgrade costs from Fast Energization go to the zones with large loads for 15 years, then to regional allocation.
filing-er27-520-pjm-tos-large-loads.quote: this allocation methodology will apply to each portfolio of IRRs identified through PJM’s Fast Energization Process for 15 years

filing-er27-520-pjm-tos-large-loads.point: Rates for the three new transmission services largely repeat those FERC approved in the co-location order.
filing-er27-520-pjm-tos-large-loads.quote: The rates for these services are largely identical to those proposed by the PJM Transmission Owners and approved by the Commission in the Co-Located Load Paper Hearing Order

filing-er27-520-pjm-tos-large-loads.point: The owners say FERC should accept their proposal whatever it decides on PJM’s companion filing.
filing-er27-520-pjm-tos-large-loads.quote: regardless of how the Commission acts on PJM’s filing, the Commission can and should determine that the key aspects of the PJM Transmission Owners’ proposal

filing-er27-520-pjm-tos-large-loads.quote: request that the Commission establish the same comment date for the instant filing that it establishes for PJM’s filing
